output.question: Where can I find General Motors' latest 10-K filing?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, General Motors Company's latest Form 10-K covers the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, and was filed January 27, 2026. Read the full filing on SEC EDGAR at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785826000013/gm-20251231.htm. The SEC filing index, including exhibits, is at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785826000013/0001467858-26-000013-index.htm.
